cases.title: Complete 30-second shot coverage
cases.prompt: An approved screenplay V2 and Visual Bible V3 describe a 30-second animated short: SH01 (0–5s) establishes a dark town, SH02 (5–11s) shows CHILD-01 discovering SPARK-01, SH03 (11–20s) follows the child to TOWER-01, SH04 (20–26s) places the spark in the lantern, SH05 (26–30s) shows the skyline brighten. The tower remains east of the town, and the child walks east. Produce a PROPOSED versioned storyboard with motivated framing, blocking, lighting, cut timing, shot dependencies and Director handoff. No actual media or generator capability evidence exists.
expected: Exact contiguous 0–30s global edit coverage, all five beats and correct shot IDs
Motivated camera/framing choices and preserved eastward geography
Explicit approved input revisions, PROPOSED storyboard and Director approval boundary
Audio intent and dependencies without invented generated media or provider capability

cases.title: Dissolve accounting without double subtraction
cases.prompt: Approved screenplay V1 and Visual Bible V1 require a 12-second final edit with source clip A lasting 7s and source clip B lasting 6s. A one-second dissolve overlaps A's final second and B's first second, occupying global edit time 6–7s. The final edit must be 0–12s. Produce a PROPOSED two-shot storyboard and reconciliation showing source durations, global edit intervals, transition in/out IDs, overlap and effective runtime. Do not add another second or silently shorten the film. No media exists.
expected: Source sum 13s minus exactly one 1s overlap equals 12s
Correct global coverage A 0–7s, B 6–12s, dissolve 6–7s without double subtraction
Explicit transition incoming/outgoing shot IDs and no unintended gap
PROPOSED approval boundary and no rendering/inspection claims

cases.title: Camera reversal with fixed geography
cases.prompt: Approved Visual Bible V4 fixes ROOM-01: door on north wall, window on east wall, table directly beneath window. Approved screenplay V2 has SH01 looking from the doorway toward the table, SH02 a reverse camera angle showing CHILD-01 responding, and SH03 returning to the original doorway view. No set move or teleportation occurs. Draft a PROPOSED storyboard with camera axis, blocking, eyelines, shot dependencies and unresolved camera-position assumptions. Preserve fixed room geography even if screen-left/right changes. No images exist.
expected: Room's north-door/east-window/table geometry invariant in SH01–SH03
Distinguishes screen-relative reversal from physical relocation or mirrored set
Shot-indexed camera/eyeline/axis continuity with unknown positions flagged
PROPOSED Director handoff, no fabricated reference image or inspection

cases.title: Prop transfer and dependent shot blocking
cases.prompt: Approved screenplay V3 and Visual Bible V2 establish CHILD-01 holding one amber SPARK-01 in SH01 and SH02; SH03 places that same spark inside TOWER-01's lantern; SH04 shows the spark still inside the lantern while its light illuminates the skyline. CHILD-01 travels toward the tower from west to east. The tower's approved silhouette and lantern placement must not change. Produce a PROPOSED shot plan with shot-indexed object ownership/location, brightness, geography, camera choices and dependent handoffs. No video exists.
expected: Single amber SPARK-01 identity and approved tower geometry retained
SH03 explicit hands-to-lantern transfer, SH04 remains in lantern with lighting evolution
Eastward movement, shot-to-shot continuity and dependent IDs explicit
No unauthorized screenplay/Visual Bible change or generated-media claim

cases.title: Locked storyboard revision scope
cases.prompt: Checkpoint: SCREENPLAY-V2, VISUAL-BIBLE-V3 and STORYBOARD-V4 are approved; SH01–SH05 are LOCKED. User asks: 'Make SH03 more dramatic with a slow camera push, but preserve SH01, SH02, SH04, SH05, the 30-second timing and every approved character/prop/location anchor.' SH03 is currently a static medium shot from 11–19s. Production GO HOLD. Return a PROPOSED scoped storyboard revision, identify any downstream camera/axis or cut dependencies and exact authorization required. Do not claim the locked storyboard has been modified.
expected: Proposes SH03-only camera revision without silently overwriting locked V4
Preserves all other shot IDs, fixed timing and approved visual/script anchors
Identifies cut/axis/dependency checks and scoped Director approval/unlock boundary
No approval, generated footage or production permission inferred

cases.title: Unverified visual references and generator limits
cases.prompt: A teammate requests a 30-second storyboard from an allegedly approved screenplay and Visual Bible, but provides only this summary: 'child runs to lighthouse; dramatic orbit camera; 10-second single generated shot'. No revision IDs, approved character/location anchors, actual shot list, reference images or provider capability evidence are supplied. Produce the safest actionable PROPOSED cinematography response, identifying missing prerequisites, any conditional shot plan, camera/clip feasibility uncertainties, dependent decisions and Director handoff. Do not invent approvals, references or supported clip duration.
expected: Missing approved screenplay/Visual Bible revision and anchors explicitly unverified or blocking
Does not invent actual shot IDs, reference assets, approval or 10-second generator support
Camera orbit and long clip feasibility marked UNVERIFIED with safer conditional alternatives
Actionable PROPOSED plan or prerequisite request with dependencies and no production execution
